doors.name: Checkpoint Access
doors.lock_text: WARDEN lockdown: sealed while hostiles are active in this section.

doors.name: Armory Locker
doors.lock_text: Mechanical lock. Security keycard, a lockpick (Security) or force.

success.reason: You asked before using her card

options.label: Pick the lock
options.failure_text: The pick slips and the lock seizes; you'll need a different approach.

options.label: Unbolt the grate
options.failure_text: A seized bolt resists. Try again or pry it loose.

options.label: Pry it loose (Strength, noisy)
options.success_text: You wrench the grate out of its frame.

doors.name: Forward Blast Door
doors.lock_text: WARDEN security lock. Override it from the checkpoint terminal, bypass the magnetic lock, or find another way around.

options.label: Bypass the magnetic lock
options.failure_text: Wrong sequence: the lock trips an alarm.

options.label: Press your palm to the scanner (Resonance credential)
Crank the dead lock open by hand (checkpoint defenses destroyed)
options.locked_text: The turret is still feeding power to the lock.
options.success_text: With the turret wrecked, the lock has no power. You crank the door open by hand.

doors.name: Sealed Ward Door
doors.lock_text: Quarantine seal. The ward intercom beside the door can talk to the people inside.

doors.name: Engineering Access
doors.lock_text: WARDEN lockdown: the cutters in this section must be dealt with first.

doors.name: Maintenance Hatch
doors.lock_text: A maintenance hatch rated for technicians. It leads toward the archive hold.

options.label: Re-route the hatch actuator
options.success_text: The actuator whines and the hatch slides open.
options.failure_text: The actuator sparks and stalls. Someone else could try, or take the long way.

doors.name: Command Chamber
doors.lock_text: Sealed from inside by command authority. There is an intercom panel beside the door.

doors.name: Evacuation Bay 2
doors.lock_text: Launch control must release the bay.

options.label: Pull the manual release
options.success_text: The blast door grinds open from this side.

options.label: Purge the ward's vented coolant
options.success_text: The ward's scrubbers cycle clean. Opening it is safe now.
options.failure_text: A jet of freezing coolant bursts from the valve. It isn't purged yet.

objects.name: Body of Chief Engineer Osei Marsh

options.label: Reseat the seal and restart the pump
options.success_text: The pump shudders and catches. Coolant pressure stabilises.
options.failure_text: Scalding vapour lashes out; the seal is still loose.

options.label: Install a Pump Seal Kit (no check)
options.success_text: The fabricated seal clicks into place and the pump restarts.

options.label: Isolate the live deck plates
options.failure_text: The junction bites back with a jolt.

options.label: Drop the crane's load on the central aisle
options.success_text: Two tonnes of cargo crash into the aisle.

options.label: Flood the central aisle with freezing coolant
options.locked_text: No pressure: the engineering coolant pumps are down.
options.success_text: A white wall of coolant fog rolls down the aisle and freezes the reclaimers in place.

on_detect.notify: Someone is breathing behind the crates.

options.label: Board the Petrel and launch
options.locked_text: The bay is not secure yet.

effects.notify: Iona Rell: "You're armed? Good. Get behind cover and help me drop these pickets!"
You slipped past the checkpoint's guns unseen.
Tav-7: "Assistance would be statistically welcome. Their cutters are aimed at my patients."
The maintenance duct carried you past the Sentinel post.
A wounded reclaimer is hiding behind the cold-storage crates.
Both coolant pumps are running. The archive purge and the bay turrets have power again.
